IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-54321 fired — HTTP 5xx rate spike detected for service `inference-gateway` in eu-west1. 5xx rate ~12% over the last 2m, route `/v1/generate` is hot. Auto-escalation threshold hit.
PagerDuty: Auto-page sent to primary oncall.

Priya (oncall): taking this. i'm at my desk. looking at metrics now.

Priya (oncall): @Alex can you confirm any infra changes in eu-west1 last 15m? any deploys or rolling restarts?

Alex (infra): no deploys from infra side in last 30m. I see a spike of 502s on the edge LB (eu-west1-b) starting ~10:02 UTC. backend pools show increased latency. digging.

Tom (sre): copying logs from gateway:
```
[10:02:14] WARN request to /v1/generate -> upstream reset by peer
[10:02:15] ERROR kvcache::evict failed: timeout
[10:02:16] INFO connection 10.40.2.8 -> closed, reason: ECONNRESET
```

Maya (prod-eng): can we check if KV cache nodes in eu-west1 had OOM or restarts? that kv cache evict + timeout looks suspicious.

Alex (infra): checking node events now. kubectl logs show sidecar restarts on kvcache-3 in eu-west1-b around 10:01. kernel oom? see `kubectl describe pod kvcache-3` shows OOMKilled x1.

Priya (oncall): OK — probable kvcache instability leading to backend errors. immediate mitigation: scale kvcache pool + enable fallback route to warm cache region.

Tom (sre): commands i ran:
```
# scale kvcache deployment
kubectl -n infra scale deploy/kvcache --replicas=6 --context=eu-west1
# temporarily increase eviction threshold
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/kvcache CACHE_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.9
```

Priya (oncall): scaling now. will also flip routing policy to prefer eu-west2 warm caches for new requests. doing canary 10% first.

IncidentBot: Routing policy update applied: traffic split 90% eu-west1 / 10% eu-west2 (canary).

Jing (support): customer check — is this impacting any active customers or logged errors in Sentry? I can pull top 5 affected orgs.

Maya (prod-eng): prioritize customers with long running sessions. @Jing please pull top orgs by error rate for /v1/generate in last 5m.

Jing (support): pulled list — orgs A, C, F show >15% error rate. opened incident summaries for each and pinged AMs.

Priya (oncall): after scale + routing canary: 5xx dropped to ~4% in first 3m. continuing to monitor.

Alex (infra): kvcache-3 shows OOM reason; node memory pressure on that AZ. I'm increasing nodepool autoscaler min and cordoning suspect node.

Tom (sre): adding a quick hotfix — add retry buffer on gateway for 502->retry with jitter to smooth spikes while cache recovers. ETA ~15m for rollout.

Priya (oncall): rolling back recent config change to caching ttl that landed 09:45 — that might have increased mem pressure. rolling back now.

IncidentBot: Deployment rollback initiated by Priya (oncall) for `cache-config` -> v1.4.7.

Maya (prod-eng): good call. that config reduced eviction aggressiveness and may have increased memory.

Priya (oncall): quick status: scaled kvcache to 6, routing canary 10% -> now 0 errors in canary. rolling canary to 50%.

Alex (infra): cordoned node ip 10.40.5.12, drained pods. node shows memory pressure from one noisy pod (OOM loop). investigating container logs.

Tom (sre): gateway retry change deployed to 3/4 of nodes, metrics show lowered 5xx for retried flows. monitoring latency impact.

Priya (oncall): last check: overall 5xx at 1.2% across eu-west1 after canary to 50%. continuing to 100% after 5m if stable.

Jing (support): AMs updated for affected orgs. customers on Slack already pinged by support. no major SLA breaches reported yet, but we'll keep trackers open.

Priya (oncall): bumping routing canary to 100% (failback to eu-west2 warm-caches for new sessions disabled), cache config rollback completed.

IncidentBot: Routing policy now 100% eu-west1.

Priya (oncall): final status for now — 5xx rate returned to baseline (~0.4%). root cause: OOM on kvcache-3 + aggressive cache config change. Mitigation: rollback cache-config, scale pool, cordon noisy node.

Maya (prod-eng): follow-ups: (1) create PR to add memory limits and oom safeguards for kvcache pods, (2) add canary gate for cache-config changes, (3) postmortem if customer impact grows.

Tom (sre): I'll own follow-ups 1+2.

Jing (support): I'll keep customer threads open and update if any regression.

Priya (oncall): closing PD-54321 for now. leaving thread open for 30m for monitoring. thanks all — :thumbsup:

PagerDuty: Incident PD-54321 acknowledged and resolved by Priya (oncall).

IncidentBot: Note: create follow-up ticket INC-2026 for kvcache memory hardening, assign to Tom.

Priya (oncall): noted. adding timeline and runbook steps to INC-2026.

Maya (prod-eng): quick retro note — we should add an alert for kvcache OOMs separate from 5xx so we can preemptively scale.

Tom (sre): ack. will add alert and a small runbook snippet.

Priya (oncall): last message — monitoring at low noise. ending active mitigation.
